assumptions: Fiscal year is calendar 2026. Reported H1 2026 GAAP diluted EPS is $1.75. Annual GAAP EPS assumptions are bear $3.45, base $3.75, bull $4.05, implying residual H2 EPS of $1.70/$2.00/$2.30 under a constant-share approximation. Management's Q3 guidance is non-GAAP diluted EPS $1.06-$1.08, so it is not directly additive to GAAP H1 EPS; the bear residual tests slower AI/cloud deployment, large-customer timing and lower margins, base assumes Q3 execution near management's non-GAAP outlook plus ordinary GAAP exclusions and steady Q4, and bull assumes stronger AI Ethernet acceptance/deferred-revenue conversion and operating leverage. P/E assumptions of 40x/50x/60x are explicit stress inputs, not observed, consensus, normal or fair multiples; they test de-rating versus sustained growth-premium outcomes at the September 22, 2026 split-adjusted close.
qualification: All EPS and P/E inputs are analyst assumptions, not observed multiples or consensus. Prices are conditional sensitivities, not forecasts, probabilities or executable quotes. The earnings period differs from the research horizon; assumption and share-basis suitability require review.
